skills.name: Same-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already have a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Unlike-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Use equivalent fractions or a common denominator to subtract fractions with different denominators.

skills.name: Mixed-number subtraction without regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract mixed numbers or whole-number parts when the fractional part of the minuend is large enough to subtract directly.

skills.name: Regrouping in mixed-number subtraction
skills.definition: Rename or borrow from the whole-number part when subtracting a larger fractional part from a smaller one.
